featured_reviews.name: Vidhi Punjabi
featured_reviews.review_text:
Review for Spa Shore (Dadar)
⚠️ Not recommended at all.

I had a very disappointing and unsafe experience here. During my massage, there was constant door knocking (16–17 times!), which was extremely disturbing and made me feel unsafe. Shockingly, the therapist even told me “please complain, the spa doesn’t understand there is a female client” and added that she was asked to open the door and massage. This is unacceptable and unprofessional.

I booked a 60-minute session for ₹2500, but got only around 40 minutes. The therapist had long nails which scratched and hurt me, and instead of giving a proper massage to relieve body knots, she just rubbed oil over my skin. There was no work done on face, head, or shoulders it was just legs and back rubbing.

When I raised concerns, the staff simply excused it saying, “your room was near the door, knocking keeps happening.” I found this dismissive if I am paying for a relaxing spa experience, I should not be constantly disturbed or put in an unsafe position.

They also charge upfront before the service, which is a big red flag because once you’re dissatisfied, you have no recourse. To add to the irony, the manager told me “visit again soon.” After such an experience, I definitely won’t.

Honestly, instead of wasting ₹2500 here, I would recommend calling UrbanClap or Yes Madam — you get a longer, more professional massage at home for under ₹2000 without the unsafe, unskilled experience.

featured_reviews.name: Pramod Vyas
featured_reviews.review_text:
Respected Owner of Sukho Thai,

Disappointed with your manager behaviour.

Building a brand and earning customer trust takes years of dedication and consistent service. However, even one employee's behavior can tarnish this hard-earned reputation. While I have consistently found your masseurs to be skilled, professional, and dedicated, the conduct of your manager has been troubling.

Today, during a session, your manager asked for payment, interrupting the experience because she wanted to close the account early. Such actions are unacceptable and unprofessional. A manager should always treat customers with respect and politeness, regardless of the situation, if really she wanted to close the account early can ask us to pay the advance and we don’t mind that or she should wait for the customer to finish the session.

We choose Sukho Thai for the quality of the treatments, even though the facilities may not be as up-to-date as those of other spas. This speaks to our appreciation for the good service your masseurs provide. However, our loyalty is being tested by the rude and dismissive attitude of your manager.

Instead of addressing our concerns, she rudely told me to leave and threatened not to accept any future appointments. This is not only unprofessional but also detrimental to your business. Customer satisfaction and respect are paramount for any business to thrive.

I hope you understand the gravity of this situation and take steps to improve the managerial conduct at your spa. Ensuring polite and respectful customer interaction is crucial for maintaining your brand’s reputation and continued success.

Why we choose brands because of trust and reliability.

Thank you for your attention to this matter.

Sincerely,

Thanks
